verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skill that guides an agent through a logo-design workflow, from brief to SVG kit. It is not a platform where users build automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The design-revision loop it does document (going back to concepts when you want changes, refining a chosen concept) concerns logo iterations, not automation version control, so it does not make the axis applicable.
